'''Ayar''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he fought as a part of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]. During the ensuing battle, Ayar was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
[[File:Teth_Monastery_entrance.png|thumb|left|250px|Members of Torrent Company enter the monastery.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were deployed to<ref name="TCWn" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Teth Databank">{{SWE|locations|teth|Teth}}</ref> to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the child of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|assault]], [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] scaled the sheer walls of the [[B'omarr Monastery]] where the Huttlet was being held. Although the company took heavy casualties, many survived the ascent, including Ayar.<ref name="TCWn" />

Upon entering the [[Monastery/Legends|monastery]], the troops were met by [[4A-7/Legends|4A-7]], a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] posing as the monastery's caretaker. Ayar, along with [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Lunn]], [[Coric]], and [[Vaize]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], confronted the droid. After incorrectly determining 4A-7 to be nothing but a simple caretaker droid, the [[Gender/Legends|men]] of Torrent Company prepared a defense against Confederacy counterattacks. Although Ayar survived the initial assault, he was killed along with all but six members of Torrent Company during the reactionary attacks from the Confederacy on the monastery.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
As a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Ayar stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Kill the lights unless we make enemy contact, night-vision visor and infrared only.|Clone Captain CT-7567 "Rex", to his troopers upon entering the monastery|<ref name="ERC" />}}
Ayar was equipped with a set of standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], and a [[Night-vision goggles/Legends|night-vision visor]] affixed to his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="TCWn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ayar first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]]. Although his death is not explicitly detailed, it is noted in the novel that only six clone troopers of Torrent Company survived, and Ayar was not one of those listed, so this article assumes he was killed at some point after the confrontation with 4A-7.<ref name="TCWn" />
